part.text:
Implemented incremental builds and caching for the SSG.

**What was added:**
- `src/cache.ts` — `.ssg-cache.json` manifest (versioned, per-page `sourceHash`, cached `frontmatter`, `contentHtml`, rendered `html`, `buildTimeMs`), template-dir hashing (`computeTemplateHash`), sha256 helpers, and `IncrementalCache` (load/save/get/set/delete with clean + corrupted-manifest handling).
- `src/ssg.ts` — `buildIncremental({ clean })` on `SsgEngine`: full hits (source + template unchanged) skip the per-file pipeline and reconstruct pages from cache (`cachedOutput`); template-only changes still reuse parsed frontmatter/html; stale outputs and cache entries are pruned; returns `BuildResult` with `BuildStats { pagesBuilt, pagesSkipped, timeSavedMs }`. Existing `build()` is untouched.
- `src/plugins/template.ts` — `afterBuild` writes cached HTML verbatim for cached pages (no re-render), keeps re-rendering for dirty pages (preserving custom-plugin transforms).
- `src/build.ts` — `buildSiteIncremental(...)`.
- `src/cli.ts` — `--incremental` and `--clean` flags for `build`; reports `Built X page(s), skipped Y, saved Zms`.
- `src/page.ts` / `src/index.ts` — `cachedOutput` flag and new exports.
- `tests/incremental.test.ts` — 25 tests covering hashing, cache round-trips, skip/rebuild/clean/missing/corrupt-cache behavior, stale-output removal, frontmatter+HTML caching, plugin-pipeline preservation, and CLI parsing/stats.

Verified end-to-end: first build 2 built/0 skipped, no-change build 0 built/2 skipped (saved 22ms), single-edit build 1 built/1 skipped.
